infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Aria listens to your daily voice check-in to learn how you feel over time. Audio stays on your device.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Aria reads your medical documents and pill bottles to extract information. Photos stay on your device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aria can read existing photos of your medical documents from your library. Photos stay on your device.
